neighbours.label: the piece ' im' as its own token at the start of a split im- word (im|itate, im|measurably, im|meuble)
fire: Parrots can imitate the sound of a ringing telephone.
The quality of the school meals has improved immeasurably this year.
Young singers often imitate the style of their favourite stars.
Il habite au troisième étage d'un vieil immeuble à Lyon.
My little brother likes to imitate the way our teacher talks.
Her confidence grew immeasurably after the first performance.
Some insects imitate the colours of poisonous species to stay safe.
Nous avons visité un immeuble ancien près de la gare.
